title: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multicenter Clinical Study of Chuanzhi Tongluo Capsule in Acute Ischemic Stroke (CONCERN): Study Rationale and Design
abstract: Background Acute ischemic stroke (AIS) remains a significant cause of disability worldwide. Current treatments, primarily intravenous thrombolysis (IVT), are limited by narrow time windows and reperfusion injury, leading to suboptimal outcomes for many patients. Chuanzhi Tongluo (CZTL), a traditional Chinese medicine, has been preliminarily recognized as a novel cerebral protection agent in animal models.Objectives This trial investigates the efficacy and safety of CZTL capsule in patients with AIS who are not eligible for IVT or who experience early neurological deterioration after IVT.Methods and design The CONCERN trial is an investigator-initiated, prospective, multicenter, double-blind, parallel-control, randomized clinical study in China. An estimated 1,208 eligible participants will be consecutively randomized to receive CZTL capsule therapy or placebo in 1:1 ratio across approximately 70 stroke centers in China. All enrolled patients are orally administered 2 capsules of CZTL or placebo 3 times a day together with antiplatelet agents for 3 months.Outcomes The primary endpoint is an excellent functional outcome, defined as a score of 0 or 1 on the mRS at 90 days. Lead safety endpoints included 90-day mortality and symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage within 48 hours.Conclusions Results of CONCERN trial will determine the clinical efficacy and safety of the traditional Chinese medicine CZTL capsule in the treatment of AIS patients.Trial registry number ChiCTR2300074147 (www.chictr.org.cn).Competing Interest StatementThe authors have declared no competing interest.Clinical TrialChiCTR2300074147Funding StatementThis clinical trial is sponsored by the Elite Talent Program of Chongqing Medical University (2023zwjktzkyjf, 20250827). The study drug was provided by Lunan Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd, Linyi, China. The sponsors had no role in the study design, data collection, analysis, and interpretation, and in drafting and submitting this article. output.reasoning: This is a study protocol describing a planned randomized controlled trial (CONCERN trial) investigating the efficacy and safety of CZTL capsule in acute ischemic stroke patients. The abstract explicitly states the study design and planned methods but does not report any empirical data analysis or results. The protocol describes individual randomization of participants to intervention or placebo in a 1:1 ratio with defined primary and safety endpoints. However, because this is a protocol paper with no data analysis, it does not meet the inclusion criteria for CONSORT compliance review, which requires analysis of empirical data from an individually randomized trial evaluating patient-level health outcomes.
